You are performing PHASE 1 (audit only) of a full redesign of the Nxeon customer portal. This is a READ-ONLY investigation of a LIVE PRODUCTION codebase.

HARD RULES (non-negotiable):
- Repo: /opt/nxeon. You may ONLY Read/Grep/Glob/ls files there. NEVER edit, create, delete, rename, or move any file under /opt/nxeon. NEVER run npm/npx/prisma/git-write/build/db commands, NEVER restart services. Do not touch /opt/nxeon-staging or /opt/nxeon-sandbox either.
- The ONLY file you may write is your report: /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/report-routes-ia.md
- Read the full redesign brief first: /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/brief-full.md (sections 02, 07, 08, 09, 17, 48, 52, 53, 74 are most relevant to you).

SCOPE: the CUSTOMER-FACING portal — app/dashboard/** (every route), auth pages (app/login, register, forgot/reset-password, verify-email), the dashboard layout/shell (app/dashboard/layout.tsx, components/portal/Shell.tsx, components/portal/CommandPalette.tsx, the nav-section definitions wherever they live), plus the marketing entry points that lead INTO purchase/deploy flows (app/(marketing)/pricing, vps, game-servers, web-hosting, domains, business-email, block-storage, free-vps, free-minecraft, migrate, matrix, nxcloud — just how they hand off into the dashboard, not full marketing audit). EXCLUDE app/admin and app/staff.

DELIVER a thorough markdown report with file:line citations covering:
1. COMPLETE ROUTE INVENTORY: every app/dashboard route (including dynamic [id] routes and sub-routes like /dashboard/tools/*). For each: purpose, the primary user actions on it, what data it loads (which server actions / lib functions / API routes), whether it has sub-tabs/segments (and how tabs are implemented), what modals/drawers/wizards it opens, its content width/layout pattern (full-bleed? max-w? centered?), and any loading/empty/error handling present. Note `dynamic`, `revalidate`, client vs server component split.
2. NAVIGATION & IA: the exact current sidebar structure (sections, items, order, labels, icons, badges), the top bar contents (search/⌘K, currency switcher, notifications, user menu, refer&earn, etc.), mobile nav behavior, the "Getting started" checklist on the dashboard, footer/support widgets. How nav items map to routes; items that are hidden/feature-flagged; dead or duplicate entries (e.g., /dashboard/tools vs marketing /tools duplicates; /dashboard/servers vs /dashboard/games vs /dashboard/hosting vs /dashboard/sites vs /dashboard/build vs /dashboard/projects vs /dashboard/claude-code vs /dashboard/nxcloud — what is each?). Terminology used for the same concept in different places.
3. COMMAND PALETTE / SEARCH: what components/portal/CommandPalette.tsx and app/api/search do today — what entity types are searchable, categories, keyboard nav, recents, actions.
4. DASHBOARD HOME (app/dashboard/page.tsx and its components): every section/widget shown, data sources, conditional states (new user vs existing), what questions it answers vs the brief's 7 questions.
5. PAGE-LEVEL INCONSISTENCIES: pages that represent similar concepts but are structured differently (e.g., server detail vs game server detail vs hosting detail vs site detail vs domain detail vs mailbox pages) — compare their header patterns, tab systems, action placement, widths. Cite concrete examples.
6. IA RECOMMENDATION INPUTS: for each product area list the customer "jobs" the routes serve; note where backend-structure concepts leak into nav (e.g., "Volumes", "Server Directory", "Matrix", "NxCloud", "Build with AI", "Projects") and what a customer-mental-model grouping would be. Do NOT design the final IA — give the facts + a first-pass recommendation with reasoning.

Be exhaustive on the inventory (this is the "no functionality gets lost" safety net). Write the report file, then return a ~300-word summary of the top findings and the report path.

1	You are working on the complete redesign of the Nxeon customer portal.
2	
3	This is NOT a cosmetic redesign.
4	
5	This is a full product-level UI/UX transformation and visual identity overhaul of the entire customer-facing Nxeon platform.
6	
7	The existing portal has been developed incrementally over many months by continuously adding features on top of previous features. As a result, there is significant inconsistency across navigation, layouts, spacing, components, typography, forms, cards, buttons, flows, visual hierarchy, terminology, asset usage, and overall UX.
8	
9	Your job is to establish a completely new, coherent Nxeon design system and then migrate the entire portal into that system.
10	
11	The result should feel like a premium, venture-backed, multi-million-dollar infrastructure / AI / cloud technology company.
12	
13	It must NOT feel like a generic SaaS dashboard.
14	It must NOT feel like a typical Claude-generated application.
15	It must NOT feel "vibecoded."

17	
18	Nxeon needs its OWN visual identity.
19	
20	==================================================
21	01. CRITICAL NON-NEGOTIABLE CONSTRAINT
22	==================================================
23	
24	DO NOT CHANGE THE BACKEND.
